name: 5-MeS-DMT
summary: 5-MeS-DMT, also known as 5-methylthio-N,N-dimethyltryptamine or as 5-methylthio-DMT, is a lesser-known psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family. It is the 5-methylthio derivative of dimethyltryptamine (DMT) and is an analogue of 5-MeO-DMT.

pharmacology.text: 5-MeS-DMT was less potent than 5-MeO-DMT and psilocin (4-HO-DMT) but more potent than 4-MeO-DMT or 4-MeS-DMT in rodent behavioral studies. It is known produce generalization with 5-MeO-DMT in rodent drug discrimination tests, with only slightly lower potency in comparison.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

summaryZh: 5-MeS-DMT是一種含氮有機硫化合物，化學式C13H18N2S，能作為致幻劑，由亞歷山大·舒爾金首次合成。
summaryZhHans: 5-MeS-DMT是一种含氮有机硫化合物，化学式C13H18N2S，能作为致幻剂，由亚历山大·舒尔金首次合成。

uses.en: It is a little-known research compound studied in animals.
uses.zh: 它是鮮為人知的研究用化合物，曾在動物身上研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是鲜为人知的研究用化合物，曾在动物身上研究。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is 5-MeO-DMT with sulphur in place of oxygen. In rodent tests it proved weaker than 5-MeO-DMT but stronger than the equivalent compounds with the group at the 4 position.
fact.zh: 它是把5-MeO-DMT的氧換成硫。在鼠類測試中，它的效力比5-MeO-DMT弱，但比對應的第4位取代化合物強。
fact.zhHans: 它是把5-MeO-DMT的氧换成硫。在鼠类测试中，它的效力比5-MeO-DMT弱，但比对应的第4位取代化合物强。
